summary: The strongest new results are a neural surrogate for final-state centrality in heavy-ion simulations, a transport-plus-hydrodynamics prediction for jet-associated hadrochemistry and diffusion-wake tomography, and the nCTEQ26 nuclear-PDF release. The most credible AI/ML use cases are physics-constrained surrogate modeling, data-driven fake-background estimation, local diagnostics for learned event representations, and HEP tokenization evaluated through downstream reconstruction tasks. Evidence is weaker for analysis-agent claims measured mainly through retrieval efficiency, and for model-building papers without direct observable or benchmark validation.
strongest_paper_summary: A small hybrid-event sample emulates final-state multiplicity and mean-pT observables at 1--2% relative error while quantifying how centrality rebinning changes event selection and downstream correlations.

papers.title: Levy-shaped femtoscopic sources from an exact solution of relativistic hydrodynamics
papers.abstract: An exact relativistic-hydrodynamic solution is proposed to generate Levy-shaped emission sources and address the tension between Levy fits to QGP femtoscopy and Gaussian source expectations.

papers.title: Final-state centrality in relativistic heavy-ion simulations from neural networks
papers.abstract: Neural networks trained on a few hundred hybrid events predict final-state multiplicity and mean pT at 1--2% relative error and quantify centrality-definition effects in Pb-Pb and Au-Au simulations.

papers.title: Dijet hadrochemistry: tomography of jet-induced medium excitation and diffusion wake
papers.short_authors: Cong Yi, Xiang-Yu Wu, Zhong Yang, Pi Duan, Guang-You Qin, Xin-Nian Wang, Wenbin Zhao
papers.abstract: A coupled transport and hydrodynamics model with hybrid hadronization predicts K/pi and p/pi enhancements around jets and chemically structured diffusion-wake depletion in central Pb-Pb.

papers.title: nCTEQ26 nuclear parton distribution functions
papers.short_authors: nCTEQ Collaboration, K. Greve, T. Jezo, A. Kusina, J. Wissmann, M. Klasen, et al.
papers.abstract: A new global nuclear-PDF analysis combines DIS, Drell-Yan, RHIC and LHC data, heavy flavor and quarkonium information, flexible parametrization, Hessian uncertainties, and public grids.

papers.title: Probing high-momentum components in 16O via zero-degree (p,d) cross-section ratios
papers.short_authors: Super-FRS Experiment Collaboration, X. Wang, H. J. Ong, S. Terashima, I. Tanihata, Y. K. Tanaka, et al.
papers.abstract: Zero-degree 16O(p,d)15O measurements extend cross-section ratios and add a new excited-state ratio relevant to high-momentum neutron components.

papers.title: Local Diagnostics of Learned Event Representations for Anomaly Detection at the HL-LHC
papers.short_authors: Donatella Genovese, Philip Ploner, Simone Scardapane, Stefano Giagu, Thea Klaeboe Aarrestad
papers.abstract: A latent-space anomaly score is paired with local Gaussian-mixture diagnostics that rank high-level observables associated with flagged event regions in a large simulated HL-LHC dataset.

papers.title: A machine-learning method for the estimation of the background from jets misidentified as hadronic tau lepton decays
papers.abstract: MUFFIN uses boosted-decision-tree reweighting on observed CMS data to learn multidimensional fake-rate corrections and reduce high-pT background-modeling systematics.

papers.title: Precision Tokenization for Multi-Modal Data in High Energy Physics
papers.short_authors: Jeffrey Krupa, Samuel Klein, Nilotpal Kakati, Daniel Murnane, Baran Hashemi, Eilam Gross, Lukas Heinrich, Michael Kagan
papers.abstract: A rate-distortion study of tokenization across four HEP modalities and two simulated detectors finds 4--11x compression with limited degradation in jet-pT regression, particle-flow reconstruction, and flavor tagging.

papers.title: HepUKE: Uncertainty-aware Knowledge Evolution for High Energy Physics Analysis Agents
papers.short_authors: Zijie Shang, Ke Li, Junkun Jiao, Shengchun Wang, Changzheng Yuan, Xiongfei Wang, Beijiang Liu, Weimin Song, Xiaoshen Kang
papers.abstract: An entropy-scored, self-evolving HEP knowledge base and early-stopping controller reduce retrieval rounds on BESIII PhysicsQA and HotpotQA benchmarks.

cautions.title: A Density Functional for Quark Matter with Screened Confinement Interactions
cautions.abstract: A screened-confinement quark-matter density functional is constructed, but the abstract does not report direct heavy-ion observables or systematic microscopic validation.
